name: Mthuli Ncube, 1% "wealth tax" on residential property (Finance Act 2023, from 1 January 2024)
detail: An annual charge on residential property: proposed in the 2024 budget as 1% on the net value of homes worth US$100,000 or more, and in force from 1 January 2024 under the Finance Act 2023 (No. 13 of 2023) for dwellings above US$250,000, with owners over 70 exempt. It is a high-value property tax on one asset class, not a tax on net wealth. Collection was suspended pending administrative and legislative changes; the deputy finance minister confirmed in September 2025 that collection had not started. Ncube and the officials who defend it are not recorded.

name: Madzivanyika (CCC MP): taxes should be on income, not wealth
detail: Headline of a December 2023 video report; opposes the property wealth tax.

name: Gracia Mashingaidze (Fight Inequality Alliance, Gweru chapter)
detail: Chapter member quoted in a February 2025 news item asking that the super-rich be taxed on property; not a public office or spokesperson role.
